text: Healthy living is about taking care of both your body and your mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit and vegetables gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking or swimming, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because it helps your brain work properly and improves your mood. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so make time to relax and talk to friends or family when you feel worried. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by setting clear limits between your job and your free time.
